definitions.PROVISION: Substantial articulated legal clauses (Pasal, ayat, huruf, angka), including clause continuation and article-specific explanation; not mere citation or a numbered cell.
definitions.ACCOUNT_FRAGMENT: Substantial tabular fiscal/account-coded expenditure rows. Nonfiscal tables or generic numbered lists excluded.
definitions.MIXED: Both substantial legal clause content and fiscal account-coded row content on the same physical page.
definitions.HEADING: Predominantly document title, preamble, contents, annex divider or section heading; no substantive clause or fiscal row content.
definitions.VISUAL: Image/scanned content requires visual/OCR interpretation and direct extracted text is insufficient; must inspect rendered page. A genuinely blank page is OTHER.
definitions.OTHER: Nonfiscal tables, forms, authority matrices, general narrative explanation or truly blank page not meeting other classes.

definitions.review_procedure: Read physical page rendering and independently extracted native Poppler page text. No adaptive receipt/prediction access. Freeze labels before evaluator.
definitions.split: Within each document hash-ranked sample, ranks1-6 DEVELOPMENT and7-12 HOLDOUT; selected before predictions and tuning.
